prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a young noble vampire drawn with large clean shapes and few small details, a clear dark outline and smooth shading (no noise, no speckled texture): pale grey-blue skin, a clear pale face with two large bright red eyes, each a clear bright spot, and two small fangs, slicked-back black hair clearly darker than the face, a tall stiff black collar, a black cape with a deep red lining kept close around the body (not flung out), a dark red waistcoat with a white cravat, one clawed hand raised in front of the chest; standing upright; centred in its own cell with empty space on both sides; palette of black, deep red, pale grey-blue skin and white. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: a clear pale face with two large bright red eyes, each a clear bright spot, the black hair clearly darker than the face.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, swooping forward toward the heroes, the body leaning low, one clawed hand raking forward in front of the chest, pulled in close (not stretched to the cell edge), the cape kept close to the body, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, recoiling, twisting away behind the cape held close in front of the body, the head turned back, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the whole body, shift the weight onto one leg and lean the torso toward the heroes with the elbows bent, so the clawed hand stays well inside its own cell; the cape stays close around the body in every cell. Draw only the parts named in the description: no bats, wings, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, white hair, wings, bat wings, a crown, a staff, a coffin, violet, purple, pink, magenta, noise, dithering.
